# WRF-Chem validation — Nov 2025 stubble episode

**Status: not yet run.** This file and `validation.png` are generated by
`python wrfchem/validate.py --wrfout <real wrfout_d02 file>` after an actual
WRF-Chem run. No synthetic or reference series is produced — if the run has not
happened, there are no numbers here.

## What will be compared

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Model | WRF-Chem d02, 3 km Delhi-NCR nest, MOZART-MOSAIC 4-bin (`chem_opt = 202`), aerosol direct + indirect feedback on |
| Field | Surface PM2.5 = dry sum of so4/no3/nh4/oc/bc/oin over the 4 MOSAIC bins, level 1, nearest cell to each CPCB station |
| Ground truth | CPCB / OpenAQ hourly PM2.5, NCR station mean, 5–14 Nov 2025 (`python -m ingest.openaq --start 2025-11-01 --end 2025-11-16`) |
| Metrics | mean bias, normalised mean bias, RMSE, correlation r, buildup/clearance timing |

## Reference skill (context only, not our result)

Published Delhi WRF-Chem performance for a comparable burning episode —
**DSS v1.0**, *Geosci. Model Dev.* **17**, 2617–2649 (2024): NMB ≈ −16 %,
RMSE ≈ 46 µg/m³, r ≈ 0.71 for episode PM2.5.

## How to run it

See [`README.md`](README.md) for the VM sizing and run order, and
[`pipeline.md`](pipeline.md) for emissions (FINN fires + EDGAR-HTAP anthropogenic)
and chemical boundary conditions (`mozbc`). The runnable configuration —
`namelist.wps`, `namelist.input` — is committed here.

## What already exists (real, live)

The ML emulator that serves the live 72-hour forecasts is validated separately
against real CPCB data: walk-forward backtest over winter 2025-26, 492k forecasts,
MAE 37.2 vs 54.0 persistence vs 62.8 climatology, positive skill at every horizon
(`models/registry/backtest_metrics.json`). That evaluation is not synthetic.
